issue.title: bob-ledger-tools 'blocked by project' pill for #prj_is_blocked residents

task_type_fields.proposal: Render a ledger chip/pill on rows tagged #prj_is_blocked (residents Blocked by their project's ^prj) that names the project and links its ^prj line, so a project-blocked row reads differently from a row blocked by its own prerequisites. The tag is machine-owned (reconcile is the authority); the pill is render-only.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Out of scope for epic bob-cli-6u (plan:202610/prj_line_project_blocking.md lists it under Deliberately not doing / publish follow-ups); proposed by bob-cli-6u.17.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-6u.17 (note #2) as a planned follow-up of the ^prj project-blocking epic.
